description: This Java test class, 'StreamedSnapshotTest', contains unit tests for the 'StreamedSnapshot' class in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.streaming' package. It includes tests for immutability, equality/hashcode, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: StreamedSnapshotTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing features of 'StreamedSnapshot', including immutability, equality, and serialization.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that 'StreamedSnapshot' is immutable and that its dependencies 'EntityId' and 'JsonObject' are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of 'hashCode' and 'equals' using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testSerialization
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of 'StreamedSnapshot' instances.
